Some places tell their story quietly.

HOHLWEG 2 · LAUBACH

From schoolhouse
to holiday home.

The official heritage register records the building at Hohlweg 2 as a former school. Its eaves-facing section is dated to 1842, with the gable-facing section added around 1900. It is the story of a house that has changed over generations.

Today, Villa Laubach connects that past with a stay at your own pace. Historic details, tall windows and individual furnishings give the house its own character.

Source: GDKE, Cochem-Zell heritage register, p. 47 ↗

THE REGION IN THE PAST

Stories that
lead you further.

Traces of the past continue beyond the house: in the Kaulenbach valley, the timber-framed villages of the Eifel and the old towns along the Moselle.
